name: M5.ResidueTailBridge.polynomial_cons
statement: ∀ (T k : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (r : Fin k → Fin T), M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple (M5.ResidueTailBridge.anchored hT r) = 1 + ∑ i : Fin k, (Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ (r i).val
guidance: Unfold ofResidueTuple and anchored; split sum over Fin(k+1) via Fin.sum_univ_succ, simplify Fin.cons_zero/cons_succ and X^0. Return only tactic lines without leading by; keep exact target.
